html:
Unique Research · Insight / Monthly · August 4, 2022 · Full rewrite — not a stub

Jul’22 China MarTech monthly. 77 listed peers, combined mkt cap ¥316.91B; month avg move +9.13% (Shifang Holdings +775%; Youzan −38%). A-share 55: 24 up, avg +0.61%; HK avg +49.7%; US 6: only Baosheng +11.6%. Primary: financing total ~¥490–510M across 12–13 deals; largest Dipu Tech ¥110M B+ (AVIC I&F). Notable Jul deals: Jingsuo A+ ¥50M; Zhongke Shuke multi-¥10M A; Weiling CRM ¥100M A; Zhilian Engine ¥2.5M angel; Chatail $10M B; Mopu equity (Jushuitan). Charts in CN images — attach on ingest.

— END —
